title: Команда учёных-ниндзя Гатчамен. Фильм
alt: Kagaku Ninja-Tai Gatchaman (1978) Gatchaman: The Movie 科学忍者隊 ガッチャマン
description: Это сокращенная театральная адаптация первого сезона оригинального телесериала.

en:
The sinister mutant Berg Katse has launched armies of henchmen and giant weapons of mass destruction against Earth. But the forces of evil are about to meet their match! The Science Ninja Team stands ready to take the battle back to the bad guys.

(Source: HIDIVE)

This is the condensed theatrical adaptation of the original TV series' first season.
